title: Audit of the nematic fuel-cell rods (SIBD): S, I, D and the ring replicate on fresh seeds 5-6 and at dt/2, but the bath makes ~70% of the surfactant; with a rod-only source the ring still forms (99%) at 1/5 the level and no longer gates fuel, so the working ring (B) holds by construction
summary: Construction: in world.py the surfactant source is ks(1+phi)/2. It runs everywhere, at about 13% of the body rate in the bath (phi ~ -0.74), and the bath covers ~90% of the domain. s is pushed to the interface by a drift up grad w, w = 1 - phi^2, a term written against the body field. The fuel source kf((1+phi)/2)^4 is effectively rods only. The fuel permeability Df/(1+5(s/0.45)^12) is a steep designed gate. A kr(phi_b - phi) relaxation (Ohta-Kawasaki type) arrests coarsening. Replication (labkit on the claimed world.py, seeds 5 and 6, T=1000): 13 and 12 persistent splits (generation 2 and 3, merge/split 0.14/0.11), 100% of 100/75 bodies ringed (rim/core 3.22/3.24), core fuel 0.55/0.54. dt/2 (world dt 0.025, seed 5): 11 persistent splits, 100% ringed, core fuel 0.56. Who makes the ring (prodshare.py, ringtable.txt): bodies (phi>0) make 24-29% of the surfactant, 42-50% counting 3 px around them. The bath holds s at 0.15-0.17, and the rim reaches 0.56, which closes the fuel gate to D/Df 0.015. Deciding control (world_rodsrc.py: source ks((1+phi)/2)^4, rods only, everything else equal; seeds 5 and 6): the ring still forms on 99% of bodies (rim/core 2.55/2.64, rim/outside 8.8/9.9), but at rim s 0.12. The gate stays open (D/Df 1.0), core fuel falls to 0.35/0.34 (the no-ring level) and persistent splits to 8/4 (ring_rodsrc_seed5.png). With the rod-only source raised 5x (ks=0.1), the rim reaches s 0.49, the gate 0.06-0.07, core fuel 0.46/0.45 and splits 11/4: a fully self-made ring can do part of the work if the rods make 5x more surfactant.

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: uniform phi plus noise over the whole domain; rods nucleate by t~100
observations.I: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md: 16-26 discrete rods with persistent tracks; 100% ring-bounded (ringtable.txt)
observations.D: rerun/seed5, seed6 FACTS: persistent splits 13 and 12, generation 2 and 3, merge/split 0.14/0.11; dt2/seed5: 11 persistent splits, generation 2

controls_run.B: rodsrc/seed5, seed6 (world_rodsrc.py: surfactant made only by the rods): ring forms (99%) at rim s 0.12, gate open, core fuel 0.35, persistent splits 8/4 vs 13/12; rodsrc_ks5/seed5, seed6 (rod-only source x5): rim s 0.49, core fuel 0.46, splits 11/4

verdicts.limitation: A ring forms whoever makes the surfactant: the rods alone give one on 99% of bodies (rim/core 2.6). But in the claimed world ~70% of the ring's material is made by the bath and drifted to the interface by a term written against phi, and only that bath top-up lifts the rim above the steep gate threshold (s 0.45, Hill n=12). The ring as claimed (a gate holding the fuel, raising division) therefore holds by construction under the RUBRIC L3 quasi-equilibrium clause, and the rod-only ring is passive. D does not depend on the ring (the ring-off arms still divide, fewer times). Two fresh seeds plus one dt/2 seed. Seed 6 divides little in every variant (4 splits with any rod-only source), so the split counts are noisy. Motility was not checked.
